name: CBK Licensed Money Remittance Providers
source: Central Bank of Kenya - Directory of Licenced Money Remittance Providers (MRPs) as at September 30, 2026
notes: The as_of date comes from the document title/filename. The directory gives no licence numbers. Date of licencing is in notes. Website is filled only where the directory prints one (Kuwapay). Two fixes for line wrapping: the Hodan name was joined from 'Ex- change' to 'Exchange', and the trailing period after Dahabshill 'Limited.' was dropped.
